national_news.title: India and European Union Discuss FTA Implementation and Customs Cooperation in Brussels
bullets: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal held high-level meetings in Brussels with European Commission Directorates-General (Trade, International Partnerships, and Taxation & Customs Union) to review Free Trade Agreement (FTA) implementation and trade facilitation.

Under the proposed India-EU FTA, tariffs will be eliminated on over 99% of Indian exports (benefiting textiles, leather, and jewellery), while India will reduce duties on over 96% of EU goods, including phased auto tariff cuts to 10% under a quota of 250,000 units.
Following the conclusion of FTA negotiations at the 16th India-EU Summit in January 2026, the agreement is targeted for signing in mid-December 2026 and full entry into force by mid-2027.

national_news.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train Flagged Off
bullets: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the 16-coach Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train from Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru.
The train covers the journey between Bengaluru and Mumbai in around 16 hours, equipped with bio-vacuum toilets, First AC hot-water showers, automatic doors, and CCTV safety systems.
The Union Government has also approved the South Corridor bullet train project connecting Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Amravati, and Chennai, reducing Bengaluru-Chennai travel time to 73 minutes.

national_news.title: President Highlights Impact of Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Campaign
bullets: Addressing the 60th Haryana Day celebrations in Kurukshetra, President Droupadi Murmu highlighted the progress under the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign, launched in January 2015 from Panipat.
The national Child Sex Ratio (CSR) at birth has increased from 871 girls per 1,000 boys in 2014 to approximately 915 by November 2025.
Haryana has become the first state in the country to procure 24 crops from farmers at the Minimum Support Price (MSP) and contributes about 3.6% to India's GDP.

national_news.title: SEBI Introduces AI Tool 'Sudarshan' and Measures Against Financial Fraud
bullets: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced an AI-based tool named 'Sudarshan' featuring a five-stage checking process to detect unauthorized activities and fraud across social media platforms.

SEBI is partnering with Google for verified Play Store badges for genuine financial apps and running the 'Samajh ke Investing Simple' awareness campaign alongside the SCORES 2.0 portal for grievance redressal.
The regulator highlighted tools such as the SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check, alongside a WhatsApp investor awareness channel available in 11 regional languages.

national_news.title: Vice President Inaugurates National Organ Transplant Games 2026
bullets: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium in New Delhi.
A World Book of Records entry was created when 570 transplant recipients and donors performed 'Tadasana' together at the venue.
The Vice President released the 'Zindagi Dobara' Calendar and felicitated Indian medal winners from the World Transplant Games 2025 held in Dresden, Germany.

national_news.title: Government Constitutes High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat 2047
bullets: The Union Ministry of Finance constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat, chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel, with a tenure of six months.
The panel includes RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Indian Bank MD & CEO Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan as members.
The committee is tasked with recommending structural, regulatory, and legislative reforms, alongside drafting a roadmap for AI integration and cyber-risk safeguards in the banking sector.

national_news.title: Union Government Releases ₹1.09 Lakh Crore Tax Devolution Instalment to States
bullets: The Ministry of Finance released an advance tax devolution instalment of ₹1,09,019 crore to state governments to accelerate capital expenditure and fund welfare projects.
This marks the second additional tax devolution instalment released in the financial year over and above the standard monthly transfers.
Uttar Pradesh received the largest share at ₹19,208 crore, followed by Bihar at ₹10,845 crore and Madhya Pradesh at ₹8,010 crore.

national_news.title: India's First Indigenous Bullet Train B28 Under Construction at BEML Bengaluru
bullets: Bharat Earth Movers Limited (BEML), in collaboration with Integral Coach Factory (ICF), is manufacturing India's first indigenous bullet train named 'B28' at its Bengaluru workshop under the Make in India initiative.
The B28 train is designed to achieve a maximum speed of 350 km/h with an operational speed of 320 km/h, and has successfully passed the mandatory squeeze test for high-speed coach integrity.
The trainsets are developed at BEML's newly inaugurated 'Aditya' complex in Bengaluru and will be deployed on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor.

national_news.title: EPFO Celebrates 74th Foundation Day; Corpus Reaches ₹32 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) commemorated its 74th Foundation Day at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre in New Delhi.
Union Minister for Labour & Employment Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted that EPFO manages a total accumulated corpus of ₹32 lakh crore serving over 8 crore active members.
The institution highlighted technological initiatives like CITES 2.01 to modernize digital delivery systems and expand social security coverage to unorganized sector workers.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Inaugurates Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik, becoming the first Indian President to hoist the flag at the event.
During the event, the President released the Kumbh Mela anthem 'Har Har Gange' composed by Ajay-Atul, an official website, and a special postage stamp.
The event emphasizes social harmony, cultural preservation, and long-term urban infrastructure transformation in Nashik and Trimbakeshwar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Appeals to High-Income Consumers to Surrender Electricity Subsidy
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary appealed to income tax payers and affluent families to voluntarily give up the benefit of 125 units of free electricity.
The Bihar state government incurs an annual expenditure of approximately ₹23,000 crore on power subsidies, costing between ₹8,000 and ₹10,000 per household.
The appeal was made during the 'Pataliputra National Youth Parliament 2.0' in Patna to save state revenue for developmental projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Transfers ₹68.51 Crore to Over 1 Lakh Dairy Farmers via DBT
bullets: The Bihar government transferred ₹68.51 crore directly into the bank accounts of 106,063 dairy farmers linked across 5,832 milk-producer cooperative societies.
Inaugurated the 'Sudha Sampark' call centre to address livestock-related queries and an Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC) for monitoring milk supply in real-time.
The dairy operations are executed by the Bihar State Milk Co-operative Federation (COMFED), which markets dairy products under the 'Sudha' brand.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt Urges Income Tax Payers to Surrender 125 Units Free Power
bullets: Bihar CM Samrat Choudhary urged tax-paying residents to relinquish their entitlement to 125 units of subsidised power to optimize state development spending.
The state government allocates ₹23,000 crore each year for power subsidies, benefiting all household income groups uniformly.
The voluntarily surrendered subsidy amount is intended to be redirected towards nation-building and youth empowerment initiatives.

bihar_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Reviews India-US Diplomatic Ties with Consuls General in Atlanta
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar held a bilateral review meeting in Atlanta with eight Indian Consuls General serving across the United States.

The high-level meeting was attended by Indian Ambassador to the US Vinay Mohan Kwatra and MEA Additional Secretary (Americas and Canada) K Nagraj Naidu to discuss trade, innovation, and educational ties.
India currently operates eight diplomatic Consulates General in the US: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Houston, Seattle, and Los Angeles.

bihar_news.title: Disqualification Row Over Bihar Independent MLCs Under Tenth Schedule
bullets: Opposition leaders in Bihar announced plans to approach the Legislative Council Chairman and court seeking disqualification of independent MLCs Bansidhar Brijwasi (Tirhut Graduates) and Rahul Raj (Saran Teachers) after they initially joined the BJP.

The disqualification demand invokes Article 191(2) and the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution, under which an independently elected legislator faces disqualification if they join any political party post-election.
Following legal objections, party leaders clarified that the independent MLCs only extended external support to the party without taking formal membership.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Makhana Exports Reach 7,265 Tonnes in FY 2025-26
bullets: Bihar's makhana (fox nut) exports reached 7,264.89 tonnes in FY 2025-26, with the US, Canada, and UAE accounting for approximately 77% of total shipments.
Bihar accounts for 85% to 90% of India's makhana production, with total cultivation covering 35,224 hectares across Mithilanchal, Seemanchal, and Kosi regions.
High-yielding varieties like Sabour Makhana-1 yield 32–35 quintals per hectare with a 55–60% pop recovery rate, with Katihar and Purnea emerging as leading producing districts.

bihar_news.title: TEA Global Experience Index Ranks Palace Museum as World's Most Visited
bullets: The Themed Entertainment Association (TEA) published the 2025 Global Experience Index, recording 161.4 million total visits across the world's top 20 museums in 2025, a 5.4% increase from 2024.
China's Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing ranked as the most visited museum globally with 19 million visitors, followed by the Summer Palace (17.38 million).
France's Louvre Museum ranked 4th globally with 9.05 million visitors, while the Vatican Museums and UK's Natural History Museum also featured in the top 10 list.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Tallest Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Statue in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the state government's decision to install Bihar's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna.
The announcement was made during a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas event at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna to honour Patel's legacy.
The proposed monument will be the largest statue among all eminent personalities established in the state, commemorating Sardar Patel's role in integrating over 560 princely states into India.
